# MindLynx

> MindLynx is a British AI studio (MindLynx Ltd, London, company number 17226845) that builds intelligence to give people back their time, their space and their money. It builds its products in the open.

## Products

- [Helix](https://helix.work): an operating system for work, built for AI agents and humans working side by side. Work moves safely and autonomously, governed from the first action.
- [Albion](https://albion.helix.work): a family of open-source models that keep reasoning sovereign, independent of the frontier labs, at a fraction of the usual cost.

## Coming next

- MindLynx Open Source: production tools (agents, scaffolding, evaluations) released for everyone to build on.
- Cortex: memory that remains yours. Announcement to follow.
- Founders Accelerator: start, test and take products to market at a fraction of the usual cost, alongside MindLynx teams.

## Partnering

Some MindLynx clients become founders of their own products, with MindLynx as a partner in the business. Ideas worth taking to market are welcome.
